CustomField.description: Names the evidence signals absent from this application at the time confidence was last computed, e.g. "verified revenue; current credit check". Written by the grounding confidence flow so the escalation reason and the agent's evidence trail can state WHY confidence is low without re-deriving the signal logic in a second place. Empty when confidence is High. Records which evidence is missing, never any figure, so it stays Internal rather than Restricted.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Which evidence was missing when confidence was last computed
CustomField.label: Grounding Signals Missing
